task: ACT sim2real: yellow cup to blue card; next hardware stage is a validated noncontact approach/pregrasp segment
priority: Train a task-specific policy whose demonstrated TCP trajectory actually approaches this cup. Do not extend or relabel the air-motion policy.

camera.name: camera_0
camera.input: RGB uint8 640x360, rotated180 exactly once by capture; no second rotation
camera.normalization: uint8 -> float/255 -> bilinear align_corners=False -> ImageNet channel normalization (verify in exact returned policy source)

provisional_geometry.source_method: known-size upright cylinder fitted to current detected cup box
provisional_geometry.destination_method: HSV blue quadrilateral intersected with retained table plane; not YOLO blue detection

geometry_limits.table_z_basis: retained 10mm mounting support and model datum, not a new independent survey

geometry_limits.tcp_reference: calibration/tcp_offset.json manual approximate +X135mm in SDK flange
geometry_limits.tcp_frame_comparison: calibration/sdk_urdf_reference_frames.json; old simulation TCP after frame mapping differs by ~29mm, physical contact point not revalidated

hardware_protocol.action: seven absolute joint rad targets + continuous gripper total width in m

runtime_reference_scope.existing_code_accepts_only: 8D aligned_noncontact_air_sequence with its signed/hash-matched bounded metadata
runtime_reference_scope.if_using_14_or_15D_state: Return complete ordered schema, units, coordinate/previous-command initialization and matching model/statistics/adapter; no padding or silent reuse of the 8D runner.

simulation_source_status.formal_current_grasp_simulation_pipeline: on the other computer; not in this package
simulation_source_status.included_robot_baseline: robot_reference/mujoco_baseline/nero.xml, for frame/asset reference, not an aligned cup scene or task demo
missing_from_this_host: current grasp demonstration collector and closed-loop evaluator

required_simulation_work: Reconstruct current recorded joint/gripper state, camera and provisional cup/card geometry; export a real-vs-rendered overlay for review.
Reconcile TCP frame mapping, table/cup clearance and the blue-square scale diagnostic before contact geometry is accepted.

Generate task-specific demonstrations that approach this cup, open sufficiently for the 75mm outer diameter and include contact only where physically validated; the old air range52..78mm is not a grasp envelope.
Train a new coherent Nero ACT checkpoint with paired statistics and full input/action schema.
Independently evaluate the same frozen checkpoint in teacher-free closed-loop scenes, with noise/corrections and the observed real execution latency; report failures without changing thresholds.
Export a complete offline preview and separately bounded noncontact pregrasp executor before any physical cup contact.
